title: Sacchariferous
summary: SACCHARIF'EROUS, adjective [Latin saccharum, sugar, and fero, to produce.] Producing sugar; as sacchariferous canes. The maple is a sacchariferous tree.

inlines.v: SACCHARIF'EROUS, adjective [Latin saccharum, sugar, and fero, to produce.] Producing sugar; as sacchariferous canes. The maple is a sacchariferous tree.
